title: Leonard Susskind | "ER = EPR" or "What's Behind the Horizons of Black Holes?" - 1 of 2
summary: Stanford physicist Leonard Susskind gives the first of two mini-lectures on "ER = EPR", the idea that quantum entanglement and wormholes are related. It covers what lies behind black hole horizons.
why: HN people point to it as the more detailed follow-up when articles touch on entanglement, holography and black holes.

quote.text: I found these lectures by Leonard Susskind very insightful
